versions.name: Camp Willett
versions.address: 1401 Camp Willett Road, Oak View, CA 93022
versions.summary: A very rustic Ventura County Council camp on a wooded hillside property near Oak View in the Ojai Valley of California, used for troop weekend camping, camporees, and training events.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Ventura County Council camp page, which confirms Camp Willett as an active, very rustic weekend-camping and camporee property near Oak View. Coordinates from scout-camp-map, approximate; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.
